title: Ouroboros V2: Reproducible Saddle-Point Escape Benchmark
description: Reproducible saddle-point escape benchmark on a synthetic 20D Ackley+saddle landscape. The repository packages fixed-seed results, a publication manuscript, falsifiability criteria, and the exact benchmark code used to compare Bare SGD, Random Langevin, HITL Spatial, Chiral p-bit, and ER=EPR Hypersphere escapes.
notes: The falsifiability contract is explicit: the claim surface fails if the committed fixed-seed validation gates no longer hold on rerun.
